task.title: M7: Publish flow: confirmation prompt, particles deploy instructions, and size check
task.description:
Add the explicit publish step on top of export. Because a Particles site is visible to everyone at AO, publishing is never implicit: codeviz export --publish <name> (or a codeviz publish subcommand) prints a confirmation prompt that names the repository, the refs being included, and the site name, and only proceeds on an explicit yes. It checks the total payload size against the Particles single-POST limit (base64-encoded files) before deploying, suggests dropping refs when over, and then either runs particles deploy out --name <site> or prints the exact command to run.

Acceptance criteria:
- The confirmation prompt names the repo (from origin or directory name), the site name, and the selected refs; a non-TTY run requires --yes to proceed.
- Size check computes the base64-encoded payload size and refuses with a per-ref breakdown when over the limit.
- With the particles CLI available and confirmed, the deploy runs and the resulting URL is printed; without it, the exact particles deploy command is printed.
- Nothing is written to ~/.config/codeviz or the repo as a side effect of publishing.
- Tests cover the prompt refusal path, --yes, and the size-check refusal with fake snapshot files.
